pickChannel: Pick a Channel to send the "Start Ticket" Message in
initDesc: Click the Button below to create a Ticket
editSteps:
1. Copy the Message URL of the "Start Ticket" Message
2. Enter the `/embed-builder create` Command and press `Start Over`
3. Create your desired Embed
4. Once done, press the `Edit` Button and paste the Message Link into the shown Text field

descriptions.type: Type of configuration to apply to tickets
descriptions.logMode: Whether logs are posted to a channel or grouped into a thread
descriptions.allowCreatorClose: Let the ticket creator close their own ticket
descriptions.category: The category ticket-channels will be created under
descriptions.channel: The channel ticket-threads will be created in
descriptions.archiveCategory: The category closed ticket-channels are moved to
descriptions.archiveDuration: Inactivity duration after which a ticket auto-closes; a reminder is sent at half-time
descriptions.logChannels: Channels that receive ticket log messages
descriptions.staffThreads: Open a private staff-only discussion thread per ticket
descriptions.staffThreadsChannel: The channel staff discussion threads are created in
descriptions.mentionRoles: Roles pinged when a ticket is opened
descriptions.mentionUsers: Users pinged when a ticket is opened
descriptions.sendMessagePrefixes: Prefixes staff use to relay a reply to the ticket creator
descriptions.dmEnabled: Let users open this kind through the DM-to-support intake funnel
descriptions.panelChannel: Channel that hosts this kind's single-kind "Start Ticket" panel
descriptions.panelButtonLabel: Label shown on the panel's create button (defaults to "Start Ticket")
descriptions.createTags: Forum tags applied when a ticket is created
descriptions.claimTags: Forum tags applied when a ticket is claimed
descriptions.closeTags: Forum tags applied when a ticket is closed
descriptions.tagClaimer: Rename the ticket post to include the claiming staff member
descriptions.remindUnclaimedAfter: Ping the claim tier this long after an unclaimed ticket opens (0 disables)
descriptions.remindUnclaimedEvery: Repeat the unclaimed reminder on this interval (0 = one-time)
descriptions.remindStaleAfter: Ping the claimer this long after the last reply on a claimed ticket (0 disables)
descriptions.remindStaleEvery: Repeat the stale reminder on this interval (0 = one-time)
descriptions.inactivityWarnAfter: Warn the creator after this long without a reply (0 disables)
descriptions.inactivityCloseAfter: Auto-close this long after the inactivity warning (0 disables)
descriptions.remindRoles: Roles pinged by the unclaimed reminder; falls back to mention then staff roles
descriptions.remindUsers: Users pinged by the unclaimed reminder; falls back to mention then staff users
descriptions.botToken: Run this ticket system under a different bot. Stored encrypted and never shown again; leave blank to keep the current value
descriptions.placementMode: Where escalated tickets live: separate spaces per tier, or one unified forum where the tier is a tag
descriptions.forumChannel: Forum or media channel that hosts every ticket when using unified-forum placement
descriptions.allowTakeClaim: Let a higher-tier staff member take an already-claimed ticket from its current claimer
descriptions.staffTierRoles: Ordered staff priority tiers (lowest first). A member's tier is the highest role they hold; take-claim needs a strictly higher tier
descriptions.ticketLimitTotal: Cap on a user's simultaneously-open tickets across this whole server (0 = unlimited)
descriptions.ticketLimitKind: Cap on a user's open tickets created from this kind (0 = unlimited)

options.unifiedForum: Unified forum (tier is a forum tag)
